title: 角色创建与成长系统不合理
description: 角色创建随机性强、选项有限、初始负面特质过多，升级和建造过程过于肝，影响玩家体验。
evidence: you don't even start with a blank character slate, instead your character starts out with 8 negative traits which you can trade "skill points" years of your age to negate
the grind on leveling up the character or the time it takes to build something is hellish
Character Creation is like doing D&D dice rolls, where almost everything (Be it positive or negative) is randomly generated.

evidence_items.quote: the only real skills that matter are hacking, zero-g ops, and eva specialization, in that order, every time
evidence_items.description: 角色创建只有黑客、零重力操作和EVA专精有用
evidence_items.quote_zh: 唯一真正重要的技能是黑客、零重力操作和EVA专精，每次都是这个顺序

evidence_items.quote: the grind on leveling up the character or the time it takes to build something is hellish
evidence_items.description: 角色升级和建造物品的肝度极高
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色升级的刷度或建造某样东西所需的时间简直要命

evidence_items.quote: Perhaps the worst character creation process ever. Not one redeeming quality.
evidence_items.description: 角色创建过程极差，毫无可取之处
evidence_items.quote_zh: 也许是有史以来最糟糕的角色创建过程。没有一个可取之处。

evidence_items.quote: you don't even start with a blank character slate, instead your character starts out with 8 negative traits which you can trade "skill points" years of your age to negate
evidence_items.description: 角色初始自带8个负面特质，需要消耗技能点或年龄来抵消
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你甚至不是从一张空白的角色卡开始，相反，你的角色一开始就带有8个负面特质，你可以用"技能点"或年龄来抵消它们

evidence_items.quote: Character Creation is like doing D&D dice rolls, where almost everything (Be it positive or negative) is randomly generated.
evidence_items.description: 角色创建几乎全部随机生成，正面或负面特质都靠随机骰子决定
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色创建就像在玩D&D掷骰子，几乎一切（无论是正面还是负面）都是随机生成的。

evidence_items.quote: ゲームに不利な身体的特質を大量に保有している状態が初期設定として固定されている
evidence_items.description: 角色创建时初始设定固定拥有大量不利身体特质，身体能力远低于标准。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 以大量拥有对游戏不利的身体特质的状态被固定为初始设定

evidence_items.quote: o jogo te faz começa com um personagem cheio de debuff que tu tem que tirar usando os poucos anos que teu personagem tem só pra tirar, e sim teu personagem tem idade e quanto mais velho pior
evidence_items.description: 角色初始带有负面状态，需要花费游戏时间移除，且年龄增长会加剧问题。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏让你开局就带着一个满是减益的角色，你得用角色仅剩的没几年时间专门去消除这些减益，没错，你的角色有年龄，越老越糟
